description: This file defines the GenericEntity class, which handles persistence and data management for entities in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for setting, getting, and manipulating entity fields, managing entity state, and integrating with the framework's model and delegator components.

classes.name: GenericEntity
classes.description: A class representing a generic entity in the OFBiz framework, capable of handling persistence, field management, and change notification for any defined entity.

classes.name: NullGenericEntity
classes.description: A singleton class representing a null or placeholder entity, immutable and used as a default or sentinel value.

classes.name: NullField
classes.description: A singleton class representing a null or placeholder field, comparable and used as a default or sentinel value.

methods.name: createGenericEntity
methods.description: Factory method to create a new GenericEntity with a specified model entity.

methods.name: createGenericEntity
methods.description: Factory method to create a new GenericEntity from an existing map of fields.

methods.name: createGenericEntity
methods.description: Factory method to create a new GenericEntity by copying an existing one.

methods.name: assertIsMutable
methods.description: Checks if the entity is mutable; throws exception if it is immutable.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the entity with a model entity.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the entity with a delegator, model entity, and fields map.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the entity with a delegator, model entity, and a primary key value.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Copies data from another GenericEntity.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the entity to an uninitialized state.

methods.name: refreshFromValue
methods.description: Refreshes the entity's data from another GenericEntity with the same primary key.

methods.name: isModified
methods.description: Deprecated method; use hasChanged() to check if the entity has been modified.

methods.name: synchronizedWithDatasource
methods.description: Marks the entity as synchronized with the data source, storing original values.

methods.name: removedFromDatasource
methods.description: Marks the entity as removed and immutable after deletion.

methods.name: isMutable
methods.description: Returns whether the entity is mutable.

methods.name: setImmutable

methods.name: getIsFromEntitySync
methods.description: Returns whether the entity was synchronized from the data source.

methods.name: setIsFromEntitySync
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating if the entity was synchronized from the data source.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity.

methods.name: getModelEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the ModelEntity object representing the entity's definition.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the delegator responsible for this entity.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the delegator responsible for this entity.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a field by name.

methods.name: isPrimaryKey
methods.description: Checks if the entity contains only primary key fields.

methods.name: isPrimaryKey
methods.description: Checks if the entity contains only primary key fields, optionally requiring values.

methods.name: containsPrimaryKey
methods.description: Checks if the entity contains all primary key fields.

methods.name: containsPrimaryKey
methods.description: Checks if the entity contains all primary key fields, optionally requiring values.

methods.name: getPkShortValueString

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field value with optional null handling, with type conversion and validation.

methods.name: dangerousGetNoCheckButFast

methods.name: setString

methods.name: setBytes
methods.description: Sets a byte array as a field value.

methods.name: setNextSeqId
methods.description: Sets the primary key to the next sequence ID generated by the delegator.

methods.name: getBoolean

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Retrieves a TimeDuration object from a field, parsing string or number.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a field value as a string.

methods.name: getTimestamp

methods.name: getTime

methods.name: getInteger
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value from a field.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Retrieves a long value from a field.

methods.name: getFloat
methods.description: Retrieves a float value from a field.

methods.name: getDouble

methods.name: getBigDecimal

methods.name: entrySet

methods.name: put

methods.name: putAll

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a field by key.

methods.name: isEmpty

methods.name: values

methods.name: size

methods.name: addObserver

methods.name: deleteObserver

methods.name: deleteObservers

methods.name: notifyObservers

methods.name: setChanged
methods.description: Marks the observable as changed.

methods.name: originalDbValuesAvailable
methods.description: Checks if original database values are available.

methods.name: getOriginalDbValue
methods.description: Retrieves the original database value for a field.

methods.name: checkFks
methods.description: Verifies existence of foreign key references, optionally creating dummy records.
